text: What I'm telling you is do not even speak to men. Do not speak to men. Ignore men for as much as you can. Do not even let men in the same space as you. Do not hold their hand. Do not text them back. Don't go on the dating apps. Delete Raya, delete Bumble. Don't post on Instagram. Ignore men for as long as you can. Men have nothing to bring to your life, whether it's money, whether it's love, whether it's whatever the fuck. Men have nothing to offer you. You are literally the most important thing in the universe, and any man that enters your life in any capacity will do nothing but deplete you of your life force. They are energy vampires. Ignore men. Do not date men. Be celibate forever, and go get your own fucking money. Okay, so let me get this straight. Women shouldn't date men? Shouldn't even talk to them? Then who should they date? Other women? But then how would they remain celibate forever? Damn, this is complicated. And the funny part is how she says don't post on Instagram while posting this on social media? Even funnier is that she does have an Instagram, and you know who she has photos and videos there with? Surprise, surprise, with men. Lady, if you can't even follow your own advice, maybe you shouldn't be giving it. Because let's be honest, this is unhinged. According to her, half of humanity is a biohazard. Men are energy vampires, have nothing to offer, bring nothing to your life. Meanwhile, every piece of technology she used to record this, the phone, the app, the studio lighting, the building, the electrical grid, was designed, built, or maintained by the same men she claims you should avoid at all costs. What is really sad is how many views and likes videos like this get. For example, this video has 250,000 views and 37,000 likes. This is nuts. And you know what else this lady promotes? Besides, of course, her wisdom about men, crypto trading. What a surprise. But guys, let women like this scream into the void about how men have nothing to offer. Meanwhile, there are good, grounded, feminine, loyal women who actually like men, respect men, and want real relationships. Those are the women you should focus on. If someone sees men as energy vampires, trust me, she is not your problem. She is her next therapist's problem.
